newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran orders employers to fire illegal aliens.
newsitem.headline: Iran orders employers to fire illegal aliens.

text.p: Iran has ordered employers to fire an estimated one million foreign workers, mostly Afghan refugees, by Saturday, saying most of them were illegal aliens.
A Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs official, quoted by the daily Hamshahri on Wednesday, said employers of foreign workers must replace them with Iranian employees by January 4.
The ministry set the deadline last month, saying most of the around one million foreigners working in the country did not hold residence or work permits.

Iran, which suffers from an official unemployment rate of nearly 11 percent, is home to two million refugees - 1.4 million from Afghanistan and 600,000 from Iraq. This makes the country of more than 60 million people the world's most important host country, according to the United Nations refugee agency.

Tehran has refused to renew residence permits of large groups of Afghans, many of whom work as unskilled labourers and construction workers in Iranian cities, and told them to return home or live in refugee camps.
